title: Count up and down
description:
Print a countdown and a count-up with loops.

```
5 4 3 2 1 liftoff
1 2 3 4 5
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
lift:   db      "liftoff", 0

        section .text
_start:
        mov     ebx, 5
        ; TODO: the countdown, then the count-up

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: `.down:` / print `rbx` and a space / `dec ebx` / `jnz .down`: `dec` sets the zero flag when it reaches 0 (lesson 3.02).
Print a space with `mov edi, ' '` and `call print_char`.
requirements: One loop counts down with `dec` and `jnz`; the other counts up with `cmp` and `jle`.
Keep the counter in a register the routines keep (`rbx`).
